verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents AuthKit as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server with OAuth applications for web, mobile, desktop and CLI clients. The Node SDK can be initialized with just a client ID for apps that can't store secrets, which points to SDK-handled public-client flows, and the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Flow is documented. Together these mean developers need not hand-roll the protocol. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of authorization code with PKCE and of refresh-token handling, plus independent hands-on corroboration of the OAuth/OIDC flows.
